t: A free Python editor with an interactive shell for trying code line by line.
steps: Find Pyzo on its official site and read the download page.
Ask IT to approve the install on managed computers.
Install a Python 3 environment such as python.org, Anaconda, or Miniconda.
Install Pyzo using the Windows installer, macOS DMG, or Linux tarball.
Choose an install location that students can write to without admin rights.
Start Pyzo and check that it finds the interpreter.
Run a first line in the shell and a first script in the editor.
